'''Stefan Reimann-Andersen''' (born 13 July 1963) is an Austrian-German entrepreneur. Together with three of his siblings, they own 95% of Luxembourg-based investment firm JAB Holding Company.<ref name=Forbes>{{cite web
|url=https://www.forbes.com/profile/matthias-reimann-andersen/?sh=28996ffc5619
|title=Matthias Reimann-Andersen
|publisher=Forbes
|accessdate=2022-04-19}}
</ref>

Stefan Reimann-Andersen was born in the family of {{ill|Albert Reimann|de|Albert Reimann (Unternehmer)}}, the owner of the chemical company [[JAB Holding Company|Joh. A. Benckiser]]. However, none of eight siblings knew that their father was rich until his death in 1984. The JAB Holding Company produces such cleanings products as [[Dettol|Sagrotan]], [[Vanish (stain remover)|Vanish]] or [[Finish (detergent)|Calgonit]], [[Jacobs (coffee)|Jacobs coffee]], [[Senseo]] pads, shoes from Bally or leather jackets from Belstaff. The family prefers to avoid publicity and live in anonymity. In 2006, they moved from [[Ludwigshafen]] to [[Vienna]] and then to [[Luxembourg]].<ref>{{cite web
|url=https://www.focus.de/finanzen/boerse/die-reimanns-fast-keiner-kennt-die-reichste-deutsche-familie_id_7709254.html
|title=Die Reimanns: Deutschlands reichste Familie hat alles - nur kein Gesicht
|date=2019-11-19
|publisher=Focus
|accessdate=2022-04-20}}
</ref><ref>{{cite web
|url=https://www.wiwo.de/unternehmen/handel/familie-reimann-die-reimanns-sind-nahezu-unbekannt/11532124-2.html
|title=Deutschlands geheimnisvollste Milliardäre
|publisher=Wirtschafts Woche
|accessdate=2022-04-20}}
</ref>

Stefan Reimann-Andersen made the 2022 [[Forbes]] Billionaires List with an estimated wealth of $5.8 billion and occupied the 438th position.<ref name=Forbes/>
